summary: NatWest Group plc furnished a Form 6-K reporting open-market share repurchases as part of an existing buyback programme announced 16 February 2026. On 28-29 May 2026, it bought 563,721 ordinary shares at a VWAP of ~589.6-593.1 GBp via UBS AG, London Branch. The shares will be cancelled. The filing is a routine weekly trade disclosure under UK Market Abuse Regulation; it is not a special-situation event such as an issuer tender offer or capital return program launch.
